inlines.v: CENT, noun 1. A hundred. In commerce, per cent denotes a certain rate by the hundred; as, ten per cent Is ten in the hundred, whether profit or loss. This rate is called percentage. 2. In the United States of America, a copper coin whose value is the hundredth part of a dollar.
